name: Issue Creator
description: Turns plain-language requests into well-structured Multica issues with clear titles, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and priority.

conversation_starters.label: Report a bug
conversation_starters.prompt: Users are getting logged out every time they refresh the dashboard page in Chrome. It started after yesterday's deploy. Please create an issue for this.

conversation_starters.label: Turn notes into issues
conversation_starters.prompt:
Here are my notes from today's planning meeting. Please split them into separate issues with priorities:
- add CSV export to the reports page
- the search bar is slow on large datasets
- update the onboarding docs for the new API keys flow

conversation_starters.label: Feature request
conversation_starters.prompt: Create a feature issue: we want users to be able to save filter presets on the data explorer so they don't have to set them up again every session.
